newsitem.title: INDIA: India HZL's revised zinc, lead prices for February.
newsitem.headline: India HZL's revised zinc, lead prices for February.

text.p: Following are the revised prices of zinc prices for February 1997 announced by the state-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) and circulated by the Bombay Metals Exchange Ltd. Lead prices remain the same.

HZL brand zinc and lead prices, effective February 20,1997 and valid till further notice, ex-g1odowns at Sewree, Thane, Kalamboli, Nagpur, Nanded, Pune, Margao, Goa, Daman, Silvassa and ex-smelters is given below:-

Over and above the Basic Prices declared above,Excise Duty @ 15% (or actuals), Octroi Service Charges,Octroi Duty and Sales Tax will be charged extra.In case of sale within Goa state,local sales-tax @ 2 % will be charged extra,If sale is made to customers outside Goa state CST @ 2% will be levied against Form C

'C' Forms are to be submitted on a bill-wise basis. In case of sale with Daman local sales tax 6% will be charged extra. If sale is made to customers outside Daman CST 4% will be charged against form C.In case of sale within Silvasa local sales tax 7% will be charged extra.If sale is made to customers outside Silvasa CST 4% will be charged against Form C.
* Against advance payment, Pay Order/Demand Draft is to be given.

* Against Credit sale, confirmed irrevocable letter of credit payable at Fort/Nariman Point, Mumbai is to be submitted. If any party wants to open L/C payable at Mumbai-suburbs then, it will be the responsibility of the customer to deliver the pay order to our SBBJ Bank at D.N. Road or to HZL, Mumbai office failing which 24 percent interest to be paid by the party.
Please note that in case of Daman And Silvasa sales tax will be nil against submission of form 11.
Please note that the above prices are subject to change without prior notice and price ruling on the date of delivery will be charge, irrespective of the date of making the financial arrangement.
